title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's alleged relationship with Chinese spy
content: The chipmaking giant says it is looking into reports by The New York Times that its CEO, Jensen Huang, was the target of a Chinese intelligence operation.

title: NASA is looking for astronauts to live and work on the Moon
content: NASA needs more recruits in order to return to the moon after being gone more than half a century.

title: Europe to join U.S.-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, defying Kremlin objections
content: France says European officials will attend this week's U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, the first three-way round of negotiations since February.

title: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
content: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, who will lead a caretaker government while negotiations take place, said: "I think everyone's over politics so let's all have a bit of a break for the next three weeks".

title: After a successful trip to Uruguay, Pope Leo heads to Argentina
content: On Sunday, tens of thousands packed the main square in Florida, Uruguay, to watch Pope Leo speak.

title: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault
content: Comedian Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.

title: SS United States, a historic ship will be sunk to create an artificial reef
content: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Alex Fogg, Natural Resources Chief of Okaloosa County, Florida, about efforts to deliberately sink the SS United States and create an artificial reef in its wreckage.

title: Climate change is altering the colors we see in the world: an illustrated journey
content: From Arctic landscapes to insect bodies, climate change is shifting the familiar colors of nature.

title: One air ambulance service rethinks what it takes to practice medicine in the sky
content: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

title: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades
content: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.
